body: A collaboration friendly studio for NeRFs
plain_description: Nerfstudio turns ordinary photos and videos into photorealistic 3D scenes you can explore, edit, and share — no 3D expertise required. It removes the technical complexity of neural radiance fields so any team can digitize real-world objects and spaces. The bottom line: capture any scene with a standard camera and get a production-ready 3D model.
technical_description: Nerfstudio is a modular Python framework for neural radiance field (NeRF) development, providing a complete pipeline from data ingestion through training to export. It supports multiple NeRF architectures (nerfacto, instant-ngp, vanilla NeRF) with a pluggable component system for fields, encodings, and model components. The framework includes a real-time web-based viewer with WebSocket streaming, CLI tools for dataset processing and model training, and integrations with COLMAP, Polycam, Record3D, and other capture pipelines. Runtime requires NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 11.7+ and leverages PyTorch with tiny-cuda-nn for accelerated rendering.
title: nerfstudio
